f1-repo-conventions.title: What shape must a new tool take to live in this repo?
f1-repo-conventions.imperative: Resolve from the repo, not from the human: where vendored tools live, how they are tested, what CI runs them, and what dependencies are available. This governs every gate's deliverable path and close criteria. Record the code evidence.
f1-repo-conventions.finding: Vendored tools live at scripts/<tool>.py (42 files), tested at tests/test_<tool>.py (49 files), 233 .py total. CI (.github/workflows/ci.yml): windows-latest, shell bash, Python 3.12, installs ONLY pytest+coverage then runs 'python -m pytest tests/ -q', a skip-guard on the junit xml, and a 90% coverage floor on checklist_engine.py. Consequence for this build: the code-map tool must be STDLIB-ONLY (the prototype already is -- ast/json/pathlib), its checks must run as pytest under tests/, and any check needing an external repo cannot run in CI. .agent-work/ is NOT gitignored (git check-ignore exits 1), so work-area artifacts are committable.

f2-incumbent-map-tool.title: Does scripts/build_architecture_map.py overlap the derived code map?
f2-incumbent-map-tool.imperative: The repo already vendors a tool with 'map' in its name. Resolve from its source whether it competes with, feeds, or is orthogonal to the derived code map -- and whether the new tool must integrate with it or merely avoid colliding with its vocabulary. A name collision in a repo whose glossary enforces one-name-one-thing is a real finding, not a cosmetic one.
f2-incumbent-map-tool.finding: NO functional overlap, but a real vocabulary collision. scripts/build_architecture_map.py (423 lines) VALIDATES AND COMPILES the hand-AUTHORED Cartographer map: it reads docs/architecture packets and enforces closed vocabularies (ALLOWED_LEVELS, ALLOWED_NODE_STATUS, ALLOWED_CONFIDENCE, ALLOWED_RELATIONSHIPS incl. the 'explained-by' the exploration amended, ALLOWED_OVERLAY_KINDS). It never parses Python source and never derives anything from code -- it is a schema compiler over authored packets. The derived code map is the opposite direction: it parses source and derives structure, authoring nothing. They are complements, not competitors, which matches the spec's own scoping (derived structural layer vs Cartographer judgment layer). Integration required: NONE for this build. But this repo's glossary enforces one-name-one-thing and 'architecture map' is already taken by the authored artifact, so the derived tool needs a distinct name -- feeds decision d2.

f3-test-corpus.title: What Python corpus can the check stage actually run against in CI?
f3-test-corpus.imperative: Gate 1 demands assertions that can go red -- determinism, referenced-by semantics, edge recall, hole count. All prototype measurements were taken on f1Brainz, which is external and READ-ONLY and unreachable from this repo's CI. Resolve what corpus exists in-repo and whether it is sufficient to exercise the assertions. Record counts.
f3-test-corpus.finding: YES -- this repo can map ITSELF, so gate 1's assertions need no external repo. Probed empirically (probe_corpus.py over git ls-files '*.py'): 233 tracked .py files, 233 parse under ast, 5232 def/class entities. Distribution: tests 2572, .agent-work 1821, scripts 785, evals 54. Three consequences. (1) A self-map MUST exclude .agent-work/ or the tool maps its own scratch and the archived prototype -- roughly 35% of entities are scratch. Excluding it still leaves ~3400 real entities, ample to assert determinism, referenced-by counts and recall floors. (2) ZERO BOM-prefixed files exist here, so gate 9's BOM defect CANNOT be exercised against this repo -- it was an f1Brainz finding and needs a purpose-built fixture file to get a failing test. (3) The prototype is NOT parameterized: astx.py hardcodes ROOT=C:\Programs\f1Brainz, hardcodes INDEX_DIRS=(src,scripts,tests), and reads a slice_manifest.json sitting next to itself. Productionizing therefore requires a real CLI/discovery layer (root, include/exclude, no manifest) BEFORE any check can run on this repo -- that work is implied by the issue but named in no gate.
